# Josie Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c23 P12](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0012), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c34 P17](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0017)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)</sub>

## Appearance

Josie is a young woman who attends school with her classmates in Avonlea and Queen's Academy.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P2](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0002), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)_

## Personality

Josie is often scornful, defiant, and lacking in empathy or tact towards her peers. She takes pleasure in showing off and triumphing over others, as seen when she dares her schoolmates to perform risky feats. Despite her unpleasant traits, she possesses natural physical agility and confidence when challenged.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c34 P17](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0017), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)_

## Traits

- Scornful and tactless  <sub>[v1 c34 P17](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0017), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)</sub>
- Defiant and competitive  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011)</sub>
- Skillful at walking board fences  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>

## Abilities

- Walking board fences with agility  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>

## History

Josie Pye grew up in Avonlea as part of the Pye family and attended the local school alongside Anne Shirley, Diana Barry, Jane Andrews, and Ruby Gillis. During a outdoor gathering in the Barry garden, she participated in a game of dares where she successfully walked a board fence and subsequently dared Anne Shirley to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof, leading to Anne's fall and injury. Following the incident, she visited Anne while she was recovering from her broken ankle. Josie later attended Queen's Academy alongside her classmates to pursue her studies, where she boarded in town and socialized with fellow boarders.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P2](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0002), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)_

## Quotes

> I don’t believe anybody could walk a ridgepole. You couldn’t, anyhow.  <sub>[v1 c23 P9](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0009)</sub>

> Then I dare you to do it. I dare you to climb up there and walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry’s kitchen roof.  <sub>[v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011)</sub>

> You’ve been crying. I suppose you’re homesick—some people have so little self-control in that respect.  <sub>[v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)</sub>
